notes: A self-contained browser narrative game with branching dialogue, resource and relationship tracking, inventory, journal, three chapters, three distinct endings, local save/load, keyboard controls, and synthesized audio feedback. Visuals are authored with CSS and no local external assets. JSON parsing, JavaScript syntax, required UI/state markers, and output structure passed code-level smoke checks. A headless Chromium launch was attempted but timed out before producing DOM output, so in-browser interaction and console behavior remain unverified. Google Fonts are optional network-loaded typography; system fallbacks are provided.
